title: Insurance claim review bundle
description: Claim intake, ontology sliver, supporting contract, workflow, and approval output.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: WorkflowBundle
metadata:
  name: insurance-claim-review
  title: Insurance claim review bundle
  description: Claim intake, supporting contract, ontology sliver, independent review, and approval output.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  workflowRef: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-insr-01
  ontology:
    ref: ladder://ontologies/builtin/insurance
    mode: sliver
    selection:
      typeIds: []
      propertyRefs:
        - insurance_claim.claim_number
        - insurance_policy.policy_number
        - loss_event.loss_date
        - loss_event.loss_description
        - coverage.coverage_position
        - claim_adjustment.recommended_reserve
      relationshipIds:
        - governs
        - arises_from
        - evaluated_as
        - contains
  forms:
    - ref: ladder://forms/builtin/first-notice-of-loss
      role: start
    - ref: ladder://forms/builtin/claim-review-decision
      role: approval
  documents:
    - ref: ladder://documents/builtin/insurance-claim-file
      role: supporting
  bindings:
    - id: claim-file-to-intake
      description: Provide the normalized claim-file contract to the workflow intake.
      source:
        ref: ladder://documents/builtin/insurance-claim-file
        path: /spec
      target:
        ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-insr-01
        path: /spec/nodes/0/inputSchema/properties/workflowFields/properties/claim_documentation
      direction: input
    - id: policy-wording-to-intake
      source:
        ref: ladder://forms/builtin/first-notice-of-loss
        path: /spec/pages/0/sections/2/fields/0
      target:
        ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-insr-01
        path: /spec/nodes/0/inputSchema/properties/workflowFields/properties/policy_wording
      ontologyPropertyRef: insurance_policy.policy_provisions_cited
      direction: input
    - id: loss-evidence-to-intake
      source:
        ref: ladder://forms/builtin/first-notice-of-loss
        path: /spec/pages/0/sections/1
      target:
        ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-insr-01
        path: /spec/nodes/0/inputSchema/properties/workflowFields/properties/loss_evidence
      direction: input
    - id: history-to-intake
      source:
        ref: ladder://forms/builtin/first-notice-of-loss
        path: /spec/pages/0/sections/2/fields/1
      target:
        ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-insr-01
        path: /spec/nodes/0/inputSchema/properties/workflowFields/properties/prior_claims_history
      ontologyPropertyRef: loss_event.loss_history_summary
      direction: input
    - id: determination-to-decision
      source:
        ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-insr-01
        path: /spec/nodes/1/outputSchema/properties/determination
      target:
        ref: ladder://forms/builtin/claim-review-decision
        path: /spec/pages/0/sections/0/fields/0
      ontologyPropertyRef: coverage.coverage_position
      direction: approval
